creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`crates/muster-cli/src/args.rs`'s `chosen(...).unwrap_or("right")` on resize is unreachable: the required arg group guarantees one of the four sides, so the default can never be read.

Moved behind the equalize branch with an accurate comment in `a_2KIH8WAnU`, but the fallback itself survives. Cosmetic - a nit rather than a bug - and the kind of thing that reads as a real default to whoever meets it next.
title: 🧹 args.rs's resize fallback is a value nothing can produce
